family_reports.body: Family court is the most corrupt thing that I have witnessed. I have watched judges, attorneys, parenting coordinator, GAL, and mediators colluded to extort fathers financially. I have witnessed multiple times of going off the record where the actors discuss their upcoming cases with each other. They make it near impossible to have a court reporter and charge you exorbitant amounts for the transcript. We believe the transcript was altered but how can you prove it. The fact that they fight to keep cameras out of the courtrooms should prove their motives.

The family court system in Tulsa county is a joke and completely corrupt. Attorneys have been allowed to drag this case out for over 5 years, then a joke of a GAL is assigned. The GAL has been unapologetically one sided with the mother. She is known around the town as anti-father, has made sexist comments, and will not listen to what the father has to say.

public_comments.comment_text: Bias. Only does telehealth meetings and schedules them only during one sides custody time. During intake, it was addressed that sessions would alternate between households. Only one meeting was conducted during the other and it was not represented honestly.
